rationale: Motor-vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder; squarely within auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking; vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information; $750 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision; other driver traveling 35 mph with no braking; vehicle trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
